items.title: What we know so far about the Berlin Pride ramming attack
items.description: A police manhunt is underway after a suspect rammed a car into a crowd at a Pride event in the German capital on Saturday night.

items.title: Firefighters battle wildfire as tens of thousands evacuated near Bordeaux
items.description: More than 330,000 people have now been evacuated from wildfires across France and Spain.

items.title: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
items.description: The event celebrated press freedom after the first dinner was cancelled by a shooting in April.

items.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
items.description: The latest attacks come two days after a clash between settlers and Palestinians near the village of Tell, which left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead.

items.title: India's 'cockroach' protest called off after education minister quits
items.description: The CJP protest has been the most visible expression of public anger against PM Narendra Modi's government in recent years.

items.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
items.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

items.title: Zelensky tries to fix crisis over removal of defence minister and counts the cost
items.description: Protests have continued over Zelensky's decision to dismiss Mykhailo Fedorov, and some commentators believe he has been damaged politically.
